test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The instructions _____ I just couldn't follow them.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a past tense verb because it refers to instructions that were given and could not be followed, indicating a **past action**.
 
• **Option 3, "were complicated",** **correctly uses the past tense** .
 
• It also matches the** plural subject "instructions".**

​Hence, the correct statement is '***The instructions were complicated__ I just couldn't follow them. '***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "is complicated", is** incorrect **because it is in the **present tense and uses the singular form.**
 
• Option 2, "are complicate", is** incorrect** because "complicate" should be "complicated" and it** lacks a past tense verb.**
 
• Option 4, "was complicated", is** incorrect** because "was" is a singular form, while "instructions" is **plural.**
